audit.why: EVEN 6/10 sits with 47.08% over 1043 games and a chart that gives Ornn 4-5, 6 and first item — the page already tells the player the lane tips against them.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 4-5 spike credits Ornn's durability to 'Call of the Forge God passive itemization'.
audit.why: Call of the Forge God is his ultimate. The passive that forges and upgrades items is Living Forge — the page attributes a passive to an ability the player is separately told to dodge, which makes both unreadable.
audit.corrected: Living Forge named as the passive; Call of the Forge God left to the level-6 material.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ornn.json (P Living Forge; R Call of the Forge God)

audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanics are wrong. (a) The knockup is attributed to 'Bellows Breath into Searing Charge' and the player is told to 'avoid standing beside walls'. (b) Call of the Forge God is called a 'double knockup' in three places.
audit.why: (a) Searing Charge knocks up when Ornn COLLIDES WITH TERRAIN — and Volcanic Rupture leaves a magma pillar, which is terrain he creates himself. Telling the player to avoid walls is useless advice because Ornn brings his own wall to the middle of the lane; that is the actual combo and it was never stated. (b) Riot's text: the elemental's first pass damages, slows and applies Brittle — the knockup only happens on the RECAST, when Ornn charges into the elemental and redirects it. Dodging the recast line is the counterplay and the page instead teaches that both hits knock up, so the player has no idea which one to sidestep.
audit.corrected: Pillar-into-Searing-Charge written into early, wants.foe[0], the first-item spike and the Do/Don't entries; the ultimate rewritten as pass-then-recast in mid, wants.foe[2] and whys[4].
sources: champ-data/_kits/ornn.json (Q Volcanic Rupture: 'a magma pillar forms at the end location', terrain; E Searing Charge: 'If Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave ... knocks up'; R Call of the Forge God recast text)

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Searing Charge at 14s is the longest gap in his engage and Call of the Forge God at 140s at rank 1 is LONGER than The Equalizer at 130s — you out-cycle his ultimate, which reframes the whole level-6 stage and was never mentioned.
audit.corrected: Q 9s, E 14s and the 140s-vs-130s ultimate comparison added to the cooldown breakdown and whys[4].

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[5] says Iceborn Gauntlet leaves you 'grounded'.
audit.why: Nothing in Ornn's kit grounds. Volcanic Rupture's derived grounding flag contradicts Riot's own description, which says only damage and a slow plus the pillar. Asserting a grounding tells a Rumble player his Scrap Shield move speed is disabled when it is not.
audit.corrected: Changed to slowed and pinned against the pillar.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ornn.json (Q Volcanic Rupture description: damage + slow + pillar)

edits.before: At level 1 it is genuinely even — Ornn has no gap-closer yet and you can walk at him with Flamespitter, but his base armor and health quietly absorb more than most tanks. Play for chip and wave control rather than trading hard; you have no Electro-Harpoon to keep him honest yet. At level 2 your E-slow-into-Q pattern is the best trade combo you get in this lane: double Harpoon to bait his Searing Charge cooldown, then walk Flamespitter on him while he cannot gap-close. By level 3 you can link it cleanly — E once to slow, Q in the Danger Zone, E again to prevent his dash — but know that his Bellows Breath W already procs the brittle passive, so avoid standing beside walls where Searing Charge can pin you.
edits.after: At level 1 it is genuinely even — Ornn has no gap-closer yet and you can walk at him with Flamespitter, but his base armor and health quietly absorb more than most tanks. Play for chip and wave control rather than trading hard; you have no Electro-Harpoon to keep him honest yet. At level 2 your E-slow-into-Q pattern is the best trade combo you get in this lane: double Harpoon to bait his Searing Charge cooldown, then walk Flamespitter on him while he cannot gap-close. By level 3 you can link it cleanly — E once to slow, Q in the Danger Zone, E again to prevent his dash — but Volcanic Rupture leaves a magma pillar behind, so he never needs a wall — Searing Charge into his own pillar knocks you up anywhere in the lane.

edits.before: Ornn's Bellows Breath W-brittle plus Call of the Forge God passive itemization means his base durability starts to wall out your Flamespitter damage in extended trades.
edits.after: Ornn's Bellows Breath Brittle plus his Living Forge passive itemization means his base durability starts to wall out your Flamespitter damage in extended trades.

edits.before: Ornn's Iceborn Gauntlet spike is severe — his Bellows Breath into Searing Charge knockup pattern becomes near-unavoidable in melee range, and your Scrap Shield alone cannot absorb the burst.
edits.after: Ornn's first-item spike is severe — Volcanic Rupture drops a pillar and Searing Charge into that pillar knocks you up anywhere, no wall required, and Scrap Shield does not stop a knockup.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are where this lane tips against you. Ornn's innate durability is not item-dependent — his passive forge bonus keeps scaling his base stats while your Danger Zone damage stays relatively flat, and his W-brittle amplifies every auto he lands. Your Heat cycle works in short bursts, but if you let a trade go long he simply out-stats you. At 6 you get The Equalizer, which is not a kill tool here — it is a deterrent. Place it across the wave to block his Searing Charge approach or as a bail-out wall if he pops Call of the Forge God; a slow Ornn who cannot walk through your rocket wall buys you enough room to reset the trade on your terms.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are where this lane tips against you. Ornn's innate durability is not item-dependent — his passive forge bonus keeps scaling his base stats while your Danger Zone damage stays relatively flat, and his W-brittle amplifies every auto he lands. Your Heat cycle works in short bursts, but if you let a trade go long he simply out-stats you. At 6 you get The Equalizer, which is not a kill tool here — it is a deterrent. Place it across his Searing Charge approach, or between you and Call of the Forge God — its first pass only slows and applies Brittle, and the knockup comes on his recast charge, so that is the line to leave.

edits.before: W-brittle you with Bellows Breath into Searing Charge knockup to set up a full trade combo you cannot walk away from
edits.after: Drop a Volcanic Rupture pillar, Searing Charge into it for the knockup, then land Bellows Breath Brittle on you

edits.before: Land Call of the Forge God double knockup at 6 to negate your Scrap Shield and chain-CC you through your only defensive tool
edits.after: Run you over with Call of the Forge God for the slow and Brittle, then recast to charge the elemental back through you for the knockup

edits.before: Call of the Forge God arrives and his double knockup punishes any aggressive commit — Scrap Shield does not absorb the full chain, so disengage with Equalizer rather than trading into his ultimate.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God only slows and applies Brittle on its first pass — the knockup comes on his recast charge, so dodge that second line and note his 140s ult is slower than your 130s Equalizer.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet locks in his tankiness and his CC chain becomes near-unavoidable in melee range — your Scrap Shield buys one moment to react before you are grounded.
edits.after: His first item locks in the tankiness and the CC chain is near-unavoidable in melee — Scrap Shield buys one moment before you are slowed and pinned against his own magma pillar.

edits.before: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — Wall-knockup setup. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — 9s, and the pillar it leaves is the terrain Searing Charge knocks you up against. - Searing Charge: 14s, his only gap-close. - His R is 140s, yours is 130s — you out-cycle him.

edits.before: Wall-knockup setup. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 9s. Its pillar is the wall his E knocks you into. Engage once it is down.

edits.before: That is Ornn's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: His Q pillar is a wall he plants anywhere — lane centre is no safer than a wall.

notes: Bellows Breath carries range 25000 in the kit file — that is a tooltip-parsing artefact for a cone advance, so no range claim was made about it. Volcanic Rupture's derived 'grounding' flag contradicts Riot's description (damage, slow, pillar) and was not used. The Iceborn Gauntlet reference in the first-item spike and the late block is an item-trend claim I cannot verify from local data, so the spike was reworded to 'first-item spike' rather than asserting a specific item; the late block still names Iceborn Gauntlet and should be checked against current Ornn builds.
